summary: Verified bug fix for 'Gagal menganalisis audio' — ffmpeg is now installed (v5.1.9, at /usr/bin/ffmpeg) and audioread reports both RawAudioFile and FFmpegAudioFile backends. Added new test module /app/backend/tests/test_audio_formats.py that generates synthetic 3s sine tones via ffmpeg in three non-WAV containers (webm/opus 32k, m4a/aac 64k, mp3/libmp3lame 64k) and POSTs each to /api/analyses. All three return 200 with full MFCC analysis: 13-value mfcc_mean/mfcc_std lists, intonation_score/clarity_score/overall_score in 0..100, non-empty ai_feedback, transcript string, duration ~3s. WAV regression path (TestAnalyses.test_siswa_upload_analysis) still passes. Full backend suite: 31/31 PASSED in 31.16s (28 previous + 3 new format tests). Frontend record.tsx web branch verified via source read: lines 99-111 correctly fetch the recorder.uri blob, read blob.type, and derive extension (webm/mp4/ogg/wav) with fallback to webm — matches the fix described in the request.
critical_code_review_comments: ffmpeg is a runtime system dependency now — must be included in the Dockerfile / container build (apt-get install -y ffmpeg) or MFCC extraction of non-WAV files will regress in fresh environments.

server.py _extract_mfcc_features writes UploadFile bytes to a NamedTemporaryFile with the client-provided suffix. Consider server-side sanitisation of Path(filename).suffix (currently accepts any extension) to prevent oddly-suffixed uploads from confusing the ffmpeg probe.

success_rate.frontend: N/A (backend-only request; record.tsx web branch code-verified)

seed_data_creation: Test analyses TEST_webm, TEST_m4a, TEST_mp3, TEST Analysis, Other created against seeded siswa. No production data mutated.
context_for_next_testing_agent: ffmpeg (v5.1.9) is required at /usr/bin/ffmpeg for non-WAV audio analysis. audioread.available_backends() must include FFmpegAudioFile. Regenerate test fixtures with: ffmpeg -y -f lavfi -i 'sine=frequency=220:duration=3' -c:a <codec> [-b:a <bitrate>] <path>. Run: cd /app/backend && pytest tests/ -v — should be 31/31.
rca_of_issue: ROOT CAUSE (from main agent): container lacked ffmpeg → audioread only had RawAudioFile backend → librosa.load() raised NoBackendError for webm/m4a/mp3 → /api/analyses caught it as generic Exception and returned 500 'Gagal menganalisis audio: ...'. Frontend compounded this by hardcoding mime='audio/m4a' on all platforms while the web MediaRecorder actually produces audio/webm;codecs=opus. FIX VERIFIED: (1) ffmpeg installed → audioread now shows [RawAudioFile, FFmpegAudioFile]; librosa decodes webm/m4a/mp3 successfully. (2) /app/frontend/app/record.tsx lines 99-111 branch on Platform.OS==='web', fetches recorder.uri as blob, reads blob.type, and picks correct extension (webm/mp4/ogg/wav, default webm) so the multipart filename matches the container the backend receives. Backend-side tests confirm all three real-world formats yield valid full analyses.
